hints.title: Consecutive Ascending Run
hints.text: A window of length k is consecutive and sorted ascending if and only if the current run length of consecutive adjacent increments is at least k.

hints.title: Run Counter Maintenance
hints.text: Track a single counter for contiguous elements where nums[i] == nums[i-1] + 1, resetting to one whenever the condition breaks.

hints.title: Power Evaluation
hints.text: For each index i >= k - 1, if the consecutive run count is at least k, output nums[i]; otherwise output -1.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass updating run length counter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-checking all k elements per window takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Tracks consecutive increment run length in a single linear pass.
